workflow_patch.description: An RFC-6902 JSON-Patch over the BASE workflow JSON that makes a small, targeted improvement. It MUST NOT alter the workflow's external contract: no changes to webhook/trigger entrypoints, httpMethod, responseMode, or executeWorkflowTrigger inputSource. Keep the patch bounded and minimal. An empty array denotes a proposal of no change; it requires scope_of_change 'no_change' and the reason stated in rationale. Never invent an operation to pad the patch.

path.description: A JSON Pointer (RFC-6901) into the base workflow JSON.

from.description: Source JSON Pointer for 'move' and 'copy' operations.

value.description: The value for 'add', 'replace', and 'test' operations (any JSON type).

scope_of_change.description: The shape of the proposed change. 'no_change' is the value required when workflow_patch is empty.
